#MediaTek is a leading global supplier of smartphone SoCs and has extended its low-power design, connectivity, and high-volume manufacturing capabilities into smart automotive systems, AI PCs, and smart home devices. In automotive applications, the companies are combining MediaTek’s Dimensity Auto with NVIDIA’s RTX and DRIVE platforms.

The partnership could create a connected ecosystem spanning cloud training, edge inference, and end-device interaction. Models can be trained on NVIDIA GPUs and within #NVLink AI Factory infrastructure before being deployed across the PCs, vehicles, and smart devices powered by MediaTek. Data and usage scenarios collected at the edge can then feed back into cloud-based model optimization. This would expand the reach of NVIDIA’s #CUDA, #RTX, and NVLink ecosystems, while enabling MediaTek to evolve from a consumer-chip supplier into a broader platform company spanning custom ASICs, AI PCs, and intelligent vehicles.
